caption:
Paneer Stir Fry
home food 101 | 30 minute recipe 

Nutrition: 
C: 22 | F: 27 | P: 16
Calories: 395 per serve
Serves 2 hungry adults, can be split into 3 portions when had as a side

As always, if you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, leave a comment and i will respond to help you out <3 

Ingredients
200 grams paneer, sliced
1 tsp oil
1 onion, thinly sliced
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
1 tomato, thinly sliced
1 capsicum, thinly sliced
spices: (feel free to adjust as per your taste)
1 tsp red chilli powder
1 tsp coriander powder
1/2 tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tsp chaat masala
2-3 tbsp water
handful coriander, to garnish 

Method: 
add oil to a pan 
add in the jeera seeds and allow to cook
add in the onions and ginger garlic paste and saute till onions are translucent 
then add in the spices and stir for a few minutes
then add in the tomatoes and if needed, some water so the mix doesn’t burn
 then add in the capsicum followed by the tomatoes 
stir it all together and add salt to taste and a generous pinch of chaat masala 
top with coriander and enjoy :) 

this tastes great as a side with dal and roti or as a filling for a roll
